name: Li Andersson - Proposition de la Commission au Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on guidelines for the employment policies of the Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament wants the European Union's yearly jobs guidelines to put quality of work first, not just the number of jobs. It asks for better wages, working conditions and social protection, more training and skills for adults, action on poverty and affordable housing, and fair rules for artificial intelligence at work. It also asks to have a say equal to national governments when these guidelines are set. The Council of national ministers must now respond.

- The text adds quality jobs, training rights, housing and anti-poverty goals to the guidelines.
- It affects workers, jobseekers, employers and national governments across the European Union.
- National ministers now decide whether to accept, change or reject the Parliament's amendments.
